quotes.text: The slightly metallic reddish-brown color scheme looks fantastic!
The Battle Droid has a pretty recognizable head and Hasbro has done a great job with it here.

Swivel/hinge ankles, 'boot' swivels, hinged knees, balljointed hips, balljointed mid-torso, swivel/hinge shoulders, bicep swivels, hinged elbows, swivel/hinge wrists, swivel/hinge neck, balljointed head, and hinged movement processors.
E-5 blaster rifle, DLT-19 heavy blaster, Sonn-Blass FWMB-10 blaster, backpack, and command officer antenna.
Non-Scalper Price: $25-$30 dollars
Saturday, February 15, 2020
The main body is a brown colouring with a grey arms and legs as well as a grey midsection.
The sculpt is excellent for the Heavy Battle Droid, with good proportions and accuracy to the shape and build of the panels.
All in all there are 20 points of articulation
two back pack options
Command Droid aerials
priced around £5 more than a standard figure
I score the Gaming Greats Heavy Battle Droid 3 out of 5.
